descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
This position provides first-line IT assistance and remote support for standard IT systems and services to supported customers. The Service Desk Analyst acts as the first point of contact for customer users, handling Level 1 incidents and service requests , ensuring accurate logging, basic troubleshooting, and timely resolution or escalation when required.
 The role focuses on delivering excellent customer service, following established procedures, and escalating more complex issues to Senior Service Desk Analysts or other technical teams in line with agreed processes.
 This position reports to the Service Desk IT Management and provides day-to-day Service Desk support (1st line duties) .
 Responsibilities 
Act as the first point of contact for end users via phone, email, and ticketing system
Log, categorise, prioritise, and manage incidents and service requests in the IT Service Management system in line with SLAs and quality standards
Provide first-line troubleshooting and resolution for common IT issues, following documented procedures and knowledge articles
Escalate incidents and requests to Senior Service Desk Analysts or appropriate technical teams when resolution is outside Level 1 scope
Ensure users are kept informed of progress and resolutions in a polite, timely, and professional manner
Support IT departmental and Service Desk policies and procedures
Contribute to an effective and customer-focused Service Desk service, ensuring a positive user experience
Update and follow Service Desk knowledge articles and standard operating procedures
Ensure ownership of assigned tickets until resolution or escalation, maintaining accurate ticket updates
Provide Service Desk support during agreed shifts or as required to meet service demand
Support standard user administration tasks under supervision or on your own, as defined within Service Desk scope
 Requirements 
 Experience in an IT Service Desk, Helpdesk or customer support role (or relevant education/training) is nice to have
Basic understanding of IT concepts including hardware, operating systems and common business application
Willingness to learn and develop technical and troubleshooting skills
Strong customer service mindset with clear and professional communication skills
Ability to follow procedures, document work accurately, and work as part of a team
Basic knowledge or exposure to: 
 Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive) 
 Printing 
 iOS 
 Windows OS 
User account and password support
Manage users and devices with Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, Intune, and Microsoft Admin
Desktop and laptop troubleshooting
Ability to identify when an issue requires escalation and follow defined escalation paths
Customer-oriented attitude with a focus on problem resolution and continuous improvement
